observations: A black game console with a three-tier chassis design characteristic of a Pro model.
The top surface features a large white Galactic Empire emblem.
The front edge of the console has 'STAR WARS' printed on it.
The text 'PS4' is visible on the front right corner.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are shown on top of the console.
A power cable and an HDMI cable are included.
The console appears to have some surface dust and light scratches.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GAMEARENAOFFICAL' is present.

claims.evidence: The three-tier design seen in photo 0 is unique to the PS4 Pro model, and 'PS4' is printed on the front.
This is a subjective marketing claim.
Performance cannot be verified from a static image.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or display an image.
risks.proof: A photo of the console connected to a screen showing the main menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be unable to read games.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game starting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a broken disc drive.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from online services (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo showing a successful login to the PlayStation Network.

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

proof_requests: Photo of the console turned on and connected to a TV showing the system settings screen.
Video of a disc being loaded and played.
Video showing both controllers working correctly in a game.
Photo of the back of the console to check the ports and warranty seals.
response.reason: The console is identifiable as a PS4 Pro Star Wars Edition from the physical design and logos. It is priced at its worst case (non-functional) because it is not shown powered on or connected to a display.
